name: Question 11
problem:
What is the variance of the following data set?

$$
-12,\,1,\,-7,\,9,\,7,\,13,\,-12,\,-15
$$

Do not round your answer.

${\sigma }^{2}=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
If we have a data set that consists of the points ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n},$ then the variance can be computed as

$$
{\sigma }^{2}=\overset{―}{{x}^{2}}-(\overset{―}{x})^{2},
$$

where $\overset{―}{x}$ is the mean of the data set and $\overset{―}{{x}^{2}}$ is the mean of the squares of the points in the data set.

First, let's compute $\overset{―}{x}.$ There are $n=8$ points in our data set, so the mean is

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i} \\  & =\frac{1}{8}\cdot (-12+1-7+9+7+13-12-15) \\  & =\frac{1}{8}\cdot (-16) \\  & =-2.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, let's compute $\overset{―}{{x}^{2}}.$ Computing the mean of the squares of the points in the data set, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{{x}^{2}} & =\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{8}\cdot ((-12)^{2}+{1}^{2}+(-7)^{2}+{9}^{2}+{7}^{2}+{13}^{2}+(-12)^{2}+(-15)^{2}) \\  & =\frac{1}{8}\cdot (144+1+49+81+49+169+144+225) \\  & =\frac{1}{8}\cdot 862 \\  & =\frac{862}{8} \\  & =\frac{431}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the variance is

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sigma }^{2} & =\overset{―}{{x}^{2}}-(\overset{―}{x})^{2} \\  & =\frac{431}{4}-{(-2)}^{2} \\  & =\frac{431}{4}-4 \\  & =\frac{431-16}{4} \\  & =\frac{415}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

If we have a data set that consists of the points x1,x2,…,xn, then the variance can be computed as σ2=x2―−(x―)2,

where x― is the mean of the data set and x2― is the mean of the squares of the points in the data set.

First, let's compute x―. There are n=8 points in our data set, so the mean is x―=1n∑i=1nxi=18⋅(−12+1−7+9+7+13−12−15)=18⋅(−16)=−2.

Now, let's compute x2―. Computing the mean of the squares of the points in the data set, we get x2―=1n∑i=1nxi2=18⋅((−12)2+12+(−7)2+92+72+132+(−12)2+(−15)2)=18⋅(144+1+49+81+49+169+144+225)=18⋅862=8628=4314.

So, the variance is σ2=x2―−(x―)2=4314−(−2)2=4314−4=431−164=4154.
